story: Car Engines: The incredible shrinking machine
text: There is a lot more to come from the ICE when it comes to manufacturing processes and the electronics. Work like this: [VIDEO] 3d printing a whole engine must surely enable some impressive things. I remember watching a little demonstration using machine learning for the engine timing once you can get the belts out.

The timing chain and the camshaft seems really inefficient; I'm looking forward to when camless designs become more mainstream. Koenigsegg (among others, I assume) has been working on this tech [0][1]. 0: [LINK] 1: [VIDEO]
